question: How should the common definition of perception based on the senses be examined?
premises: Perception is commonly said to rest on the sphere of the eye and other senses.
That definition is a received teaching.
The verse proposes to examine that teaching.
inference: Therefore the sense-based definition of perception must be critically analyzed rather than accepted as final.
plain_english: And so the teaching that perception rests on the sphere of the eye and other senses is now examined.
